parakeet: Here's how it happens. You notice something small, something real, something others didn't. Maybe someone seems a little more withdrawn today, their shoes are untied, their shoulders slumped, they spoke less than usual. And you say, I feel like something's wrong. They say, Wow, God just showed you that. But it wasn't a revelation. It was observation plus intuition plus pattern awareness. Yet, because the church lacks psychological literacy, your brain gets rebranded as the spirit. And once that happens, you're no longer being curious, you're now being used.
